context: Aoi packs a gift carefully for a friend's birthday.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ひな、贈り物の包装、手伝ってくれる?
lines.en: Hina, would you help me wrap this gift?
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Soft opening, natural rhythm. The easy confidence of an adult who knows a child will say yes. Gentle lift at the end.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: もちろん!愛情、こもってますね。
lines.en: Of course! You can really feel the love going into it.
lines.style: Bright, eager voice. Quick uptake on the first phrase, then thoughtful slowdown. Noticing something real. Genuine delight without performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: I want to put a real promise into this one.
lines.style: Tender, slightly solemn. Careful weight on 「誓い」. Not heavy—reverent. Speaking aloud something she half-means for herself. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 丁寧な気持ち、伝わるね。
lines.en: You can feel how much care went into it.
lines.style: Soft, observant. Not just agreeing—truly seeing it. Small pause before 「伝わる」. Child-warm, not patronizing. Genuine recognition.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お友人、心、喜ぶといいな。
lines.en: I hope their heart feels how much this means.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wistful. Slower pace on 「喜ぶ」. Vulnerability underneath—caring about whether it lands. Warm but a little uncertain, hopeful.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: こうやって、渡すの、素敵!
lines.en: The way you hand it over makes it even more special.
lines.style: Pleased, observant brightness. She's noticing Aoi, not just the gift. Quick warm tone, landing softly. Simple delight in the moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ふふ、お前と一緒で、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm so glad I'm doing this with you.
lines.style: Affectionate, genuine laugh underneath. Relaxed ease. The weight of something real—not performing emotion, just feeling it. Warmth that comes from presence, not effort.
